speech.heard: In USA, global trade accounts for only 25% of economic output. Sudan is the world's lowest, where trade equals just 2% of total output. Trade is the sum of exports and imports of goods and services. The largest economies trade less relative to their size. USA is 25%, and China is 38%. Climbing higher, Pakistan has 27%, India has 46 percent, UK has 62 percent, Germany has 79 percent, and Mexico has 80 percent. How much of your country's economic output comes from global trade?
